category_title: Student with developmental delay and learning disabilities exhibiting disruptive behaviors and repetitive questioning
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete two-digit addition problems during a whole-class math instruction time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please complete the two-digit addition problems on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks anxious) I don't know how to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to answer them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks ashamed of herself for not performing well) It's too hard, I can't do it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep looking at the numbers and try again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Feels unhappy and becomes disorderly and unsettled, pushing the materials away) No!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please complete the two-digit addition problems on your worksheet.

STUDENT: (Looks anxious) I don't know how to do this.

TUTOR: Just try your best to answer them.

STUDENT: (Looks ashamed of herself for not performing well) It's too hard, I can't do it.

TUTOR: Keep looking at the numbers and try again.

STUDENT: (Feels unhappy and becomes disorderly and unsettled, pushing the materials away) No!

task.content: Complex instruction time for others, such as two digit additions

context.materials: Kit comprising assorted colouring sheets, art material and crayons, exclusive display board
context.social_setting: Classroom setting where others are receiving complex instruction

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: If she feels unhappy or perceives she is not performing well
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Stressed, anxious or ashamed of herself for not performing well
related_quotes: I don’t want her to feel stressed, anxious or ashamed of herself for not performing well. If she feels unhappy, she becomes disorderly and unsettled.

behavior_patterns.condition: When facing tasks beyond her level
